description: ALF is now firmly embedded in Tanner family life, but secrecy remains a daily problem as his friendships widen to Jody and Jake and his schemes become more ambitious. The season moves from neighborhood mishaps and family crises to the unusually reflective Christmas special, while the cost and responsibility of sheltering ALF become harder to ignore.

s02e01.description: ALF is challenged to survive an entire week in the Tanner house without breaking or destroying anything.

s02e02.description: Obsessed with reruns of Gilligan’s Island, ALF dreams himself into the castaways’ tropical world.

s02e03.description: After Raquel is ridiculed for claiming she saw ALF, he tries to restore her confidence without exposing himself.

s02e04.description: Disturbed by a Melmacian taboo surrounding his parents’ marriage, ALF runs away and takes refuge at a monastery.

s02e05.description: When the Tanners become part of a television ratings sample, ALF manipulates their viewing to save his favorite show.

s02e06.description: Unable to go trick-or-treating, ALF infiltrates Willie’s Halloween gathering and starts interfering with Willie’s career.

s02e07.description: After Lynn is dumped for another girl, ALF enters her in a beauty pageant in an attempt to rebuild her confidence.

s02e08.description: Dorothy and Whizzer’s wedding is threatened when ALF develops a stubborn case of Melmacian hiccups.

s02e09.description: Willie revisits his youthful adventurous streak by taking ALF to a rail yard and hopping a freight train.

s02e10.description: ALF and the Tanner children try to revive Kate and Willie’s romance by recreating their Niagara Falls honeymoon.

s02e11.description: A presidential debate sends Kate into a series of dreams in which she finds herself campaigning against ALF.

s02e12-13.description: A Christmas trip takes ALF from a remote cabin to a children’s hospital, where he befriends a seriously ill girl and helps a young mother.

s02e14.description: ALF befriends Jake, the Ochmoneks’ streetwise nephew, adding another person to the small circle that knows his secret.

s02e15.description: ALF is placed on trial inside the Tanner household after being accused of breaking the Ochmoneks’ window.

s02e16.description: When Willie’s Uncle Albert dies after unexpectedly seeing ALF, ALF becomes convinced that he caused the man’s death.

s02e17.description: Willie becomes head of the neighborhood watch, but ALF commandeers the radio network and begins impersonating him.

s02e18.description: After spotting a burglar near the neighbors’ house, ALF leaves safety behind and tries to investigate the crime himself.

s02e19.description: ALF temporarily moves in with his blind friend Jody and discovers that independent apartment life is not quite what he imagined.

s02e20.description: The Tanners bring home a stray dog, creating an awkward household rivalry for a Melmacian with very different ideas about pets.

s02e21.description: Willie’s commitment to nonviolence is tested when Brian’s school bully and the boy’s aggressive father push the family too far.

s02e22.description: A promotion threatens to move the Tanners to San Diego, prompting ALF to interfere before Willie uproots the family.

s02e23.description: ALF becomes disturbingly attached to a ventriloquist dummy that seems to take over more and more of his behavior.

s02e24.description: ALF poses as a hallucination to frighten Kate’s alcoholic friend into confronting her drinking problem.

s02e25.description: The Tanners plan a celebration for ALF when his loneliness over being the last known Melmacian becomes overwhelming.

s02e26.description: Feeling guilty about the money the Tanners spend supporting him, ALF takes on a ridiculous number of newspaper routes.
